title: List toolbar below `sm`: the Filter, Export and Add record buttons render icon-only with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces "button"
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible defect with a named location, reproduced on two surfaces.

## Symptom (measured at 375 × 812, HotCRM `crm_account`, objectui `d4bc81e`)

**Runtime console** (`/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_account`):
- The toolbar's accessibility tree reads `- button`, `- button "Display"`.
- The first entry is `toolbar-filter-trigger`: role button, 38 × 28 px, accessible name empty, no `aria-label`, no `title`.

**Studio Data pillar** (`/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data?surface=object:crm_account`):
- The tree reads `- button`, `- button "Refresh"`, `- button`.
- The unnamed entries are the Filter trigger and the Add record button.

`getByRole('button', { name: 'Filter' })` finds 0 at 375 px and 1 at 1280 px, on both surfaces.

reach: the console list toolbar and the Studio Records toolbar (UI doors), measured once each as above.

## Cause

`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` on objectui `03cf7b2` (line numbers unchanged from `d4bc81e`). Each of these buttons stays visible below `sm`. Its only text is a `<span className="hidden sm:inline">` label, and it carries no `aria-label`:

| button | label line | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Filter (`toolbar-filter-trigger`) | :5140 | When filters are active, the count badge (:5141–5145) becomes the button's whole name, a bare number. |
| Export | :5504 | Wide form only (`!compactToolbar`). Not measured at 375 px; the markup is the same. |
| Add record, top (`add-record-button`) | :5657 | |
| Add record, bottom (`add-record-button`) | :5901 | |

Neighbouring buttons already name themselves: Print sets `aria-label` (:5568), Share sets `title` (:5544), and Display, Search and Refresh set both. The Sort, Group, Hide fields and Color triggers are `hidden sm:inline-flex` as a whole, so below `sm` they are absent rather than unnamed.

## Fix

Give each of the four buttons an `aria-label` from the same i18n key as its visible label: `list.filter`, `list.export`, `list.addRecord`. An `aria-label` replaces the badge text, so with active filters the Filter label carries the count itself: a new key (for example `list.filterActive`, "Filter, {{count}} active") in every locale pack. Keep the existing `data-testid`s.

## Acceptance

1. At 375 px, in both the runtime console and Studio, `getByRole('button', { name: … })` finds Filter and Add record. Export is found in a non-compact toolbar.
2. A unit test renders the toolbar and asserts each button's accessible name, including Filter with one active filter.
3. CONTROL: at 1280 px each visible label is unchanged and no button is announced twice ("Filter Filter").

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The fix reader is the `domain:ui` lane that owns `plugin-list`. It is not part of epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446.

## Dedupe (2026-10-15, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

- "list toolbar icon-only buttons accessible name aria-label mobile Filter Add record Export": 8 hits, none this defect. Relevant toolbar cards came back, so the channel was live: objectui#12462 (open), objectui#12423, objectui#11984, objectui#10512 and objectui#5153.
- "unnamed button screen reader small viewport list view toolbar label hidden sm:inline": 0 hits.

Filed by seat `domain:ui#4` (session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) from a Studio walk of HotCRM requested by the maintainer.
